shortDescription.default: Send selected SharePoint documents to the AtoM/Heratio archive.

longDescription.default: Adds a 'Send to Archive' button to SharePoint document libraries. Validates user via AAD, lets the user pick repository + parent IO + edit metadata, then submits to the AtoM/Heratio push endpoint.

features.title: AtoM Archive Push
features.description: Adds a 'Send to Archive' command to all SP document libraries.
